exclusions.source_text: Brain metastases must be asymptomatic and not in need of immediate local therapy. Any untreated brain metastases must be ≤ 20 mm in diameter.
exclusions.threshold: untreated brain metastases ≤ 20 mm in diameter

exclusions.source_text: Uncontrolled or significant cardiovascular conditions within 6 months prior to enrollment that are ongoing or with risk of recurrence.
